title: The Last Way Out
summary: As the Thunder Celestial Realm breaks apart and void cracks open, Wang Lin turns his Thunder Celestial Realm fragment seal into a vessel that the cracks cannot destroy and steers it toward the Thunder Celestial Temple's teleportation formation. He saves Zhan Yun, Zhan Konglie's cousin, and charges every rescued cultivator ten thousand Immortal Stones for their life plus ten thousand per hour, and soon Xizi Feng, Zhou Zhou, Hu Kailai, Liu Wenying and many others pay to come aboard. Shengong Hu joins him, calls him Master in front of everyone, and is told to disguise himself and stay out of any fight. At the teleportation fragment, the second-rank envoy Liao Qian and the other temple envoys mean to leave, destroy the formation and let the trespassers die with the realm. Wang Lin attacks with the Net-Severing Sword Art, the rescued cultivators pour their origin power into him, and he overpowers the envoys, but the formation is wrecked in the struggle. Li Yuan uses his family's restriction art, which can revive dead formations, to power it once, and the grateful survivors ask the name of their savior: Xu Mu.

cultivation: Zhan Yun: late Ascendant, fallen from Illusory Yin. Xizi Feng: late Ascendant. Zhou Zhou: early Ascendant. Hu Kailai and Liu Wenying: Corporeal Yang. Liao Qian: second-rank envoy, Corporeal Yang. Among the rescued, the strongest are three early Corporeal Yang.
